messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Validation error: field 'bundle' must be an integer
parts:
Folks,

We had an issue this evening with deployApp() returning the error:
"400 - Validation error: field 'bundle' must be an integer."

This was because of a JSON encoding problem within the shinyapps package. I went ahead and pushed a hotfix for the shinyapps package. 

Everyone will need to upgrade this shinyapps using the following command:

devtools::install_github("rstudio/shinyapps")
Thanks
-Andy
